source.title: Red is Not Dead
source.description:
Hm, speaking of secrets, I have been working on a new project: luxury packs for our highest ranking soldiers. They must be large, crafted from the finest silks, and most importantly, as red as the crest of the Scarlet Crusade.

The material is the easy part, I intend to use your dawnwoven threads for this. Finding the perfect dye, however, is well beyond my capabilities. Scour the world in search of the perfect red hue and I'll consider you a partner in this endeavor by sharing my final design with you.
source.objective: Acquire a variety of materials that could be used as a vibrant red dye. red dye and Red Rose may be sourced from vendors. Firebloom may be acquired by Herbalists. Blood of Heroes can be found in the Plaguelands. Crimson Bladeleaves to extract dye from can be found near Lake Mennar in Azshara.
source.progress:
Take your time, truly. This is nothing more than a passion project of mine. I care far more about finding the most fitting red dye we can find than stocking these on my shelves, and I would rather you put that same care into your work than rush the job for my sake.

I'll be here.
source.completion:
You have a natural eye for beauty! Not that I ever doubted you, but I didn't expect to immediately find a shade of red that would resonate so strongly with me. Yet, you brought me several!

<Taylor admires the dye candidates one by one, unphased by the idea that one vial is full of blood.>

The ones labelled "Blood of Heroes" and "Crimson Bladeleaf" are my favorites, and it is a tough choice. I think it makes sense for the two of us to use different dyes, so I'll take the bladeleaf.
